name: Hide & Seek Black Bourbon
ingredients_raw: SUGAR, REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), REFINED PALM OIL, COCOA SOLIDS (3.4%), INVERT SUGAR SYRUP, IODISED SALT, RAISING AGENTS (503(ii), 500(ii)) AND EMULSIFIER OF VEGETABLE ORIGIN [SOY LECITHIN]. CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURAL FOOD COLOURS (150c, 150a) AND ADDED FLAVOURS (NATURE IDENTICAL AND ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES - CHOCOLATE, VANILLA). *INCLUDING 2% AS SPRINKLED SUGAR
